headline: Emerson Expands Ovation AI Portfolio with New Intelligent Agents
summary: Global automation leader Emerson (NYSE: EMR) today introduced new Ovation™ AI Agents for the power and water industries, expanding the AI capabilities of the Ovation Automation Platform 4.0 release. The five new agents – Sequence Assistant Agent, Alarm Insight Agent, Predictive Maintenance Agent, Root Cause Agent and Loop Performance Monitor Agent – will empower plant personnel with critical insights by continuously monitoring, analyzing and recommending actions across critical plant operations.
